# strettchcloud_region (Data Source)

Finds a single region by its slug. An unknown slug is an error when read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up one region by slug.
data "strettchcloud_region" "kgl" {
  region = "KGL-1"
}

# List every region in the catalog.
data "strettchcloud_regions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Region slug, e.g. `KGL-1`. Filter and output.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) ISO country code, e.g. `RW`. Output only.
- `id` (String) Region identifier. Output only.
- `name` (String) Region name, e.g. `Kigali-1`. Output only.
